card.name: Percentages of patients in results
card.fires_on: Digits, decimal points, the % sign and linking words like "of" or "about" inside a percentage figure, mostly when a share of patients or income is being reported.

modes.label: Digits and % sign
modes.description: The number or % sign inside a percentage of patients with an event or finding.

modes.label: Words around a share
modes.description: Words like "of", "total" or "about" in a phrase that states a proportion.
modes.example: the average U.S. consumer spends only 10 percent<< of>> his/her disposable income on food
